title: Trajectory Aerodynamics, Approach Angles (VAA/HAA) & Whiff Lift
summary: Derived full-population terminal flight velocities at y=1.417 ft, VAA, HAA, plate_x_norm, and attack zones over 14.64M pitches in DuckDB. Proved flat VAA (VAA_diff > +1.5 deg) produces +52% relative lift in Four-Seam fastball whiff rate.
hypotheses: Approach angles (VAA/HAA) provide orthogonal predictive information to raw velocity and IVB.
Four-seam fastballs entering high with flatter VAA than expected produce non-linear whiff lift due to batter perceptual motor error.

formulas.plate_x_norm: plate_x * (case when stand = 'L' then -1.0 else 1.0 end)

title: 4-Quadrant Platoon Physics, Break Symmetry & Situational Pitching Effectiveness
summary: Quantified full-population pitching mechanics across RvR, RvL, LvL, and LvR using Silver v_statcast_features. Established Batter-Perspective Horizontal Break (hb_away_in) as the physical driver of platoon splits: glove-side breaking pitches (ST/SL) lose 4.9-7.5 pct whiff and ~2-3 pct CSW against opposite-hand batters while offspeed (CH/FS) inverts the edge. Derived Pitcher Platoon Vulnerability Index (PVI) and verified out-of-time stability (r = 0.885).
hypotheses: Platoon splits are physically driven by horizontal break direction relative to the batter (hb_away_in), not merely pitcher handedness.
Evaluating pitchers on CSW%, xwOBA, and RV/100 prevents undervaluing ground-ball sinkers (SI) that generate low whiffs.
Pitchers lacking an opposite-hand offspeed weapon exhibit elevated PVI and suffer amplified 3rd-TTO xwOBA degradation.

formulas.hb_glove_in: hb_in * (CASE WHEN p_throws = 'L' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)
formulas.hb_away_in: hb_in * (CASE WHEN stand = 'L' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)

title: Commit-Point Pitch Tunneling & Platoon-Conditioned Stuff+ / Location+ / Pitching+
summary: Materialized exact y0=50ft -> y=23.8ft commit-point pitch tunneling across all 19 seasons (10,201,496 consecutive pairs, strictly sorted ADR-001 ZSTD Parquet, 0 bad rows, 0 inversions) and trained strictly chronological Regular-Season (game_type='R') xgboost hist Stuff+, orthogonal Location+, Pitching+, and Pitching+Tunnel models over 2015-2026. All tree models beat empirical and analytical Ridge baselines on locked 2025-2026 run value and swing-and-miss whiff deception; mlbr Stuff+ hits split-half r = 0.975 in 100 regular-season pitches (vs. 0.078 for Raw RV/100), achieves YoY r = 0.878 (vs. ERA r = 0.188), and correlates at r = 0.817 with FanGraphs Pitching+.
hypotheses: Reconstructing exact (x50, z50) from (plate_x, plate_z) eliminates the 2.87 in mean (4.69 in p95) naive release-point commit-point tunneling error.

Non-linear gradient boosted trees (xgboost hist) over platoon-normalized aerodynamics and fastball differentials strictly outperform empirical and linear Ridge baselines on locked 2025-2026 regular-season run value.
Commit-point pitch tunneling features add measurable out-of-sample lift to swing-and-miss deception (Whiff Log-Loss & ROC AUC on paired swings) and next-season pitcher SIERA/FIP forecasting.
Physics-based Stuff+ stabilizes to true-talent signal in 50-100 regular-season pitches and predicts next-season K% and SIERA more reliably than lagging ERA.

title: Chronological True-Talent Player Projections: Marcel, Delta-Method Aging & Tier 1 Physics Priors
summary: Built audit-hardened Tier 2 chronological true-talent projection engine for MLB pitchers and batters across 2002-2027 (10-year rolling Tango Marcel vs. Midpoint Delta-Method Aging 2016-2025, 7-year Statcast Physics 2019-2025, locked 2024->2025 FanGraphs OOS with Stage-2 Residual mlbr Stuff+ and Hawk-Eye Bat Tracking, and secondary 2025->2026 Regular-Season Statcast OOS). Introduced Pulled Air-Ball%, Zone-Chase Selectivity (Z-O Swing%, SEAGER-inspired proxy), Sweet-Spot%, Fastball Velocity Momentum, sum-before-shrink seasonal PVI, and exposure-calibrated 80% uncertainty bands.
hypotheses: Era-adjusted sum-before-divide Tango Marcel with component-specific pre-2016 reliability M strictly beats naive prior-year persistence across every pitching and batting metric.

Midpoint harmonic-mean Delta-Method aging curves eliminate cross-sectional veteran survivorship bias and expose true post-30 biological decline (though Tango's damped piecewise-linear age adjustment remains competitive standalone, while Delta-Method aging feeds Stage-1 M4 cleanly).

Blending Marcel+Aging with strictly chronological Tier 1 Statcast Physics (mlbr Stuff+/Location+/Pitching+, seasonal PVI, Pulled Air%, EV90, Zone-Chase Selectivity) yields statistically significant out-of-sample weighted RMSE reduction on locked 2025 and 2026 outcomes.
Exposure-calibrated residual variance models produce well-calibrated ~80% projection uncertainty bands for downstream Level 4 Monte Carlo game simulation.

formulas.marcel_rate_shrinkage: mu_lg_{T-1,g} + SUM(w_k * N_{T-k} * (r_{T-k} - mu_lg_{T-k,g})) / (SUM(w_k * N_{T-k}) + M_r)
formulas.delta_aging_midpoint: lm(delta ~ ns(age - 0.5, knots = c(24.5, 30.5)), weights = 2*N_{s-1}*N_s/(N_{s-1}+N_s)) + linear boundary extrapolation
